sources.construct_role: Exact two-digit occupation employment for technology/software and science/engineering.

sources.construct_role: ISCO-08 major-group employment; exact for skilled trades group 7 and supporting-only for broad professionals/technicians.
sources.coverage_result: 88 of 91 stable countries; Antigua and Barbuda, Grenada and Ukraine absent.
sources.comparability: Balanced internationally comparable panel combining reported and imputed country estimates; country estimates with limited information carry higher uncertainty.
sources.licence: ILO content is available under CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise indicated.

sources.construct_role: ISIC Rev.4 section F construction, K finance/insurance and Q health/social-work employment.
sources.coverage_result: 88 of 91 stable countries; the same three absences as the occupation model.
sources.comparability: Balanced internationally comparable panel; sections are broad and must be named exactly.
sources.licence: ILO content is available under CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise indicated.

sources.construct_role: Detailed supporting route for J62/J63, M71/M72, Q86, K/M/N families and construction divisions.
sources.coverage_result: No tested detailed family reaches the 60-country hard floor; fresh M72 research employment reaches 54.
sources.comparability: Observed ISIC Rev.4 two-digit rows, but source/year/status gaps are material.
sources.licence: ILO content is available under CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise indicated.

sources.construct_role: Current unmet labour demand by economic activity; occupation breakdown is voluntary and experimental.
sources.coverage_result: European regional scope; cannot satisfy geographic breadth for the 91-country universe.
sources.comparability: Generally comparable but country coverage and establishment scope differ.

sources.publisher: Cedefop and Eurostat Web Intelligence Hub
sources.construct_role: Near-real-time online job-advertisement demand by occupation and skills.
sources.coverage_result: EU, EFTA and United Kingdom only.

sources.construct_role: Potential gap-filling observations for Canada, Japan, Korea and New Zealand.

sources.construct_role: Large relevant employers with material in-country employment.
